name: rLLM
summary: Reinforcement-learning framework that reuses agent harnesses for evaluation and training, collecting rollouts and rewards across sandbox backends.
description: Python 3.11+ source install via uv pip install "rllm @ git+https://github.com/rllm-org/rllm.git". CLI entry points include rllm eval and rllm train; @rllm.rollout wraps custom agents. The framework integrates CLI harnesses, Harbor task directories, Docker/Daytona/Modal/local execution and verl, Tinker and Fireworks training backends. Model gateway traces feed reward computation and policy updates. Apache-2.0 software; GPU, model and third-party platform services are separate.

agent_access.notes: Public source installation, Python API and CLI. Backend/service credentials depend on the chosen execution and training configuration.
